svg.title: CPU used and CPU requested
svg.desc: CPU used against CPU requested for each setup in 20 minutes of repeated peaks, cycles and the sudden jump. HPA+ requested more CPU just before each peak; the HPA formula's pods used all of their requested CPU during every peak.
svg.text: The same 20-minute windows as the traffic figure. The line is the CPU requested by running pods, 1 CPU each; the
shaded area is the CPU they used. Where the area reaches the line, the pods were full and requests had to wait.
CPU used, shaded in each setup's colour
